term: world-indexed actual mereology under one whole-first causal grounding profile
definition: One five-role Bool-world interpretation has the same rigid necessary concrete whole at both worlds, with two disjoint actually existing contingent proper parts at EACH world and replacement of the pair across worlds. The required IntendedProfile and exact same direct support satisfy P2At and P3At at every world. Each actual-domain subtype inherits existing nonempty-Bool-subset parthood; standard StrongSupplementation, Sum2 Fusion of its active pair into the whole, standard overlap-disjointness and actual endpoint guards hold jointly. No actual proper-part candidate is necessary or proper at every world. Whole-first support has no reverse part-to-whole support. This structural survivor refutes automatic worldwise part-freeness from this P2/P3 package, not fixed-order persistence theorems, intrinsic adequacy, reality fit or Catholicism. Whole necessity/support are assignments, not a new NE derivation.
note: Global Body has whole and atom(cohort,slot): one whole plus four atoms. ExistsAt w admits whole and the two atoms of cohort w. R/Causes is whole-to-each-active-atom, exactly shared for P2/P3. Abstract is empty, all candidates concrete, and independent thin power belongs only to whole. Each Actual w is the existing-being subtype, ordered by an injective content map to UniversalFusionBoundary.Body. ActualPart guards both endpoints and subset content; it is not fixed global parthood, and no absent reflexive self-part is counted actual. World indices are modal alternatives, not time or temporal turnover. The interpretation omits universal constituent-to-whole existential priority; physical causal and ontic support application remain OPEN. Rejected three-object candidate, original frozen stub and exact semantic revision are preserved in docs/notes/worldwise-composite-ground.md.
